All 18 rules have been searched across the full document and a single plan submitted for each.

Highlights for the reviewing workers:

- **Located and substantive**: LOL-CAP (§15.3 plus a separate Loan Agreement §15), INDEMN (§15.1/15.2 with MS-specific indemnities in Attachment 6), T4C/RENEWAL (the asymmetric SOW §2.0 twelve-month notice against six-month renewals is the flag to examine), GOVLAW (New York, with jury waiver and a shortened limitations period), ASSIGN (§16.2 mutual consent, §16.5 sale/merger), IP (§13.1 assigns MSL inventions to IBM — favourable), LICENSE (§13.3 and Loan Agreement), WARRANTY (SOW §19 suite plus §14.2 and §17), MINCOMMIT (no stated minimum, but the §5.2 inventory buy-back plus Appendix 4 Supply Flexibility is the functional exposure), TRANSITION (§5.2/5.3 exit mechanics; no true exit-assistance obligation found).
- **Runs in our favour, do not flag**: MFN (p1099 most-favoured-customer pricing to IBM), AUDIT (all audit rights run against MSL), LD (delinquency adjustments and recall costs borne by MSL; only p0722 cancellation charges could touch us).
- **Likely absent**: NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, and INSURANCE (only consigned-inventory and tooling cover at p0909/p1107, no general CGL/E&O package).
